scope: New project-specific qualification tasks, not frozen evaluation tasks

tasks.instruction: Implement plan_segment_reads(lengths, offset, limit). lengths contains nonnegative segment lengths. offset is a nonnegative absolute position in their concatenation. Return a list of [segment_index, offset_in_segment, number_to_read] covering up to limit consecutive units, skipping empty segments and stopping at the total length. Return [] for limit <= 0 or offset >= total length. Do not mutate inputs. Return only Python source, without markdown.

Implement scan_tlv_frames(hex_text). Input is valid even-length hexadecimal text. Interpret the decoded bytes as consecutive frames: one unsigned byte tag, one unsigned byte payload length, then that many payload bytes. Return {frames: [{tag: integer, payload_hex: lowercase hex}, ...], error_offset: null} when complete. If a header or payload is incomplete, return the previously complete frames and error_offset equal to the byte offset of that incomplete frame's tag. Empty input has no frames and no error. Return only Python source, without markdown.

Implement render_scope_segments(segments). Each segment is a dict with text (string), kind (string) and optional known_bad (bool). Concatenate text without separators. Return {text: concatenation, loss_mask: list of integers, one per Unicode character}. A segment gets mask 0 if known_bad is true or kind is EVIDENCE, TOOL_RESULT, WRONG_HYPOTHESIS or FAILURE_OUTPUT; otherwise mask 1. Preserve all text including known-bad context. Empty input returns empty text and mask. Do not mutate inputs. Return only Python source, without markdown.
